moves.label: Collier Spin Kick
moves.description: Instant high spin kick with long active pressure and quick recovery.
moves.reason: High spinning leg arc fits Sanji's neck-height Collier-style kicks.

moves.label: Low Table Kick
moves.description: Slow low kick with a long active sweep and weak left tracking.
moves.reason: Low leg sweep travels across the shin line with weak-left tracking.

moves.label: Black Leg Rush
moves.description: Instant mid kick rush with very long active pressure and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Long forward kicking sequence reads as Sanji's core Black Leg pressure.

moves.label: Heavy Chef Kick
moves.description: Slow mid kick with a long active swing and measured recovery.
moves.reason: Standing kick arc hits through the body line.

moves.label: Mouton Shot Tornado
moves.description: Slow mid jumping tornado kick with long active spin pressure.
moves.reason: Airborne spin-kick sequence supports tornado and jump properties.

moves.label: Concasse Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid launcher with a tiny active kick and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Upward kick posture and authored launch height fit Concasse-style launcher.

moves.label: Aerial Heel Drop
moves.description: Slow mid jumping heel drop that ends crouched after a modest active hit.
moves.reason: Airborne kick drops into a crouched finish.

moves.label: Low Table Tornado
moves.description: Slow low tornado sweep that ends crouched after a long active spin.
moves.reason: Low spinning sweep is authored as tornado and finishes crouched.

moves.label: Low Joue Launcher
moves.description: Quick low jumping launcher with a modest active kick and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Low kick jumps into a launcher with authored launch height.

moves.label: Diable Jambe Tornado
moves.description: Quick mid jumping tornado kick that knocks down after a long active spin.
moves.reason: Large airborne spin sequence is authored as tornado, jump, and knockdown.

moves.label: Crouch Spin Kick
moves.description: Quick mid crouch spin with long active pressure and almost no recovery.
moves.reason: Full-crouch entry rolls into a body-height spin kick.

moves.label: Crouch Concasse Launcher
moves.description: Steady mid crouch launcher with very long active kick pressure.
moves.reason: Crouch kick route rises into a launcher with authored height.

moves.label: Diable Jambe Drive
moves.description: Slow special knockdown drive with huge active kicking pressure.
moves.reason: Long special kick rush is authored as a knockdown drive.

moves.label: Overdrive Aerial Kick
moves.description: Steady mid overdrive jump kick with even timing and balanced recovery.
moves.reason: Overdrive kick leaves the ground without a launcher or knockdown flag.

moves.label: Sidestep Low Sweep
moves.description: Steady low sidestep sweep with a brief active kick and high recovery.
moves.reason: Sidestep kick uses the low sweep family.

moves.label: Sidestep Aerial Kick
moves.description: Steady mid sidestep jump kick with even timing and balanced recovery.
moves.reason: Sidestep special enters the same aerial kick animation.

moves.label: Rising Aerial Kick
moves.description: Steady mid while-rising jump kick with a tiny active hit and high recovery.
moves.reason: While-standing route leaves the ground into an aerial kick.

moves.label: Ducking Low Sweep
moves.description: Steady low ducking sweep with a brief active kick and high recovery.
moves.reason: Down kick uses the low sweep family.

moves.label: Diagonal Concasse Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid diagonal launcher with very long active kick pressure.
moves.reason: Down-forward kick rush is authored as a launcher.

moves.label: Diagonal Low Sweep
moves.description: Steady low diagonal sweep with a brief active kick and high recovery.
moves.reason: Down-forward kick repeats the low sweep animation.

moves.label: Black Leg Rushdown
moves.description: Quick mid rushdown with very long active spin-kick pressure.
moves.reason: Forward route chains multiple Sanji kicks at body height.

moves.label: Advancing Low Sweep
moves.description: Steady low advancing sweep with a brief active kick and high recovery.
moves.reason: Forward kick uses the same low sweep family.

moves.label: Black Leg Low Sweep
moves.description: Steady low quarter-circle sweep with a longer active kick and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Quarter-circle kick is a low sweep variant with extra active time.

moves.label: Diable Jambe Knockdown
moves.description: Slow mid jumping kick that knocks down after a tiny active hit.
moves.reason: Quarter-circle kick leaves the ground and is authored as knockdown.
